Santa Maria, São Pedro E Matacães

blurb.text: A PDO wine region in Lisboa, centered on the town of Torres Vedras, whose high yields were long used by bulk producers for inexpensive table wine. Allowed grapes include Castelão, Touriga Nacional, Aragonez, Arinto and Fernão Pires.
